questions.text: Revenue Assurance & Tax Compliance: Paying fair share: (1) Accurate declaration of revenues; (2) Tax compliance (Corporate, VAT, Excise); (3) Prevention of leakage; (4) Mobile Money tax compliance; (5) Transfer pricing transparency (multinationals); (6) Audit status (Big 4?); (7) Relationship with tax authority.
questions.evidence_required: Tax clearance certificates, Audited financial statements, Transparency reports
questions.africa_specific_notes: Telcos are often the largest taxpayers. Disputes over tax (e.g., MTN Nigeria) are common and high-stakes.

questions.text: Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC): Ethical business: (1) ABC policy enforcement; (2) Gift & Hospitality register; (3) Due diligence on partners/agents; (4) Whistleblower channel effectiveness; (5) Interaction with government officials; (6) Lobbying transparency; (7) ISO 37001 certification.
questions.evidence_required: ABC policy, Training records, Whistleblower logs
questions.africa_specific_notes: License renewals and spectrum allocation are high-risk moments for bribery.

questions.text: Truth in Advertising (Telecom): Honest offers: (1) 'Unlimited' definition clarity; (2) Network speed claims (4G vs 4G-ish); (3) Free data promotion terms; (4) Lottery/Competition fairness; (5) No hidden charges in ads; (6) Comparison advertising ethics; (7) Clarity on device financing.
questions.evidence_required: Marketing approval process, Ad samples, Consumer complaints
questions.africa_specific_notes: Misleading 'Unlimited' offers are a major grievance. Lotteries ('Win a Car') often seen as scams.

questions.text: Sales Agent Ethics: Preventing mis-selling: (1) No forced SIM registration; (2) No unauthorized VAS activation; (3) Honest explanation of tariffs; (4) Protection of vulnerable customers (elderly); (5) Agent code of conduct; (6) Mystery shopper audits; (7) Sanctions for unethical agents.
questions.evidence_required: Agent code of conduct, Disciplinary records, Mystery shopper reports
questions.africa_specific_notes: Agents under pressure to hit targets often register SIMs without consent or activate services secretly.

questions.text: Digital Inclusion Strategy: Connecting the unconnected: (1) Rural coverage expansion (beyond license obligations); (2) Affordable device financing; (3) Digital literacy programs; (4) Gender gap reduction initiatives; (5) Services for disabled (USSD accessibility); (6) Refugee connectivity support; (7) Low-cost tariffs for poor.
questions.evidence_required: Inclusion strategy, Rural rollout data, Device financing terms
questions.africa_specific_notes: The 'usage gap' (people covered but not using) is the new challenge. Cost of devices is the main barrier.

questions.text: Environmental Stewardship (E-Waste & Carbon): Green telecom: (1) E-waste management (phones/batteries); (2) Carbon footprint reduction (solar towers); (3) Recycling programs for users; (4) Sustainable packaging; (5) Energy efficiency; (6) Compliance with environmental laws; (7) Net-zero targets.
questions.evidence_required: Sustainability report, E-waste certificates, Carbon data
questions.africa_specific_notes: Diesel generators at towers are massive polluters. E-waste from cheap phones is a growing crisis.

questions.text: Human Rights & Surveillance: Protecting dissent: (1) Policy on government shutdown requests; (2) Transparency on interception requests; (3) Freedom of expression support; (4) Impact assessment of technology; (5) Protection of journalists/activists data; (6) UN Guiding Principles alignment; (7) Global Network Initiative membership.
questions.evidence_required: Human rights policy, Transparency reports, Shutdown protocols
questions.africa_specific_notes: Internet shutdowns during elections are common. Telcos are often ordered to block social media. How they respond matters.

questions.text: Algorithmic Ethics (Credit Scoring): Fair lending: (1) Transparency of credit scoring (for mobile loans); (2) Bias testing (gender/location); (3) Explanation of rejection; (4) Data sources used (ethical?); (5) Interest rate caps; (6) Debt collection ethics; (7) Right to appeal score.
questions.evidence_required: Credit scoring methodology (summary), Bias audit, Loan terms
questions.africa_specific_notes: Mobile loans (Fuliza, M-Shwari) use telco data. Algorithmic bias can exclude whole regions or groups.

scoring_notes: Layer 5 (Integrity) for Telecom in SSA: Tax compliance and anti-bribery are corporate baselines. Human rights (shutdowns) and ethical lending are the frontier issues.
